arguments.query_text: Read the final current mall level, scoped dirty packages, geometry bounds and authored actor count.
arguments.python_script:
import unreal,json
u=unreal.get_editor_subsystem(unreal.UnrealEditorSubsystem)
e=unreal.get_editor_subsystem(unreal.EditorActorSubsystem)
actors=e.get_all_level_actors()
dirty=unreal.EditorLoadingAndSavingUtils.get_dirty_content_packages()+unreal.EditorLoadingAndSavingUtils.get_dirty_map_packages()
rows=[]
for a in actors:
    if a.get_actor_label() in ['GroundFloor_Floor_01','Gallery_F1_Floor_01','RemovableRoof_Ceiling_01','Atrium_Prop_01']:
        c,x=a.get_actor_bounds(False); rows.append({'actor':a.get_actor_label(),'bounds_center':[c.x,c.y,c.z],'bounds_extent':[x.x,x.y,x.z]})
unreal.log(json.dumps({'world':u.get_editor_world().get_path_name(),'actor_count':len(actors),'bounds':rows,'dirty_mall':[p.get_name() for p in dirty if '/Environment/Mall/' in p.get_name() or '/Generated_Materials/M_Mall' in p.get_name()],'other_dirty_count':len(dirty)}))
